query.description: Handshake query. Send `key` (an API key) or `session`; `since` resumes a dropped connection.

key.description: API key when header auth isn't available (prefer `Authorization: Bearer fc_key_...`). Only on a connection from this machine, unless the owner allowed API keys over LAN.

since.description: Optional last processed `seq` for lossless reconnect replay.

live.description: Live multiplexed dashboard & API integration stream with sequence replay (`?since=seq`). API keys receive only frame types allowed by their scopes and never receive `account` frames.

account.summary: Ferrocast cloud account sign-in transition (PC session only, never sent to API keys).

auto_config.summary: Encoder auto-config progress and result: the same `AutoConfigView` the `/studio/engine/auto-config` routes return. Sent on connect only while a run is not idle.
auto_config.x-ferrocast-scopes: PC session and the owner's remote only; never sent to API keys

brb.summary: OBS BRB scene state (`{ on, scene }`).

chat_highlight.summary: Pinned or cleared featured chat message.

event.summary: Normalized stream event (follow, sub, gift_sub, tip, bits, raid, chat_message, etc.).

giveaway.summary: Active giveaway state, entry count, or winner.

golive.summary: Multistream output state, per-destination resolved quality, encode groups/budget, and live bitrate telemetry.

held.summary: Message/event held by safety filters (`{ event_id, reason }`).

held_resolved.summary: Held event released or dropped (`{ event_id, outcome }`).

hello.summary: Initial handshake with highest sequence number (`{ seq }`).

links.summary: Updated "My links" and resolved overlay link state.

notice.summary: Engine status notice or panic warning (`account:*` notices suppressed for API keys).
notice.x-ferrocast-scopes: read_only, alerts, studio_control, go_live (chat sees panic only)

poll.summary: Active poll progress or end state.

resync.summary: Ring buffer gap notice (`{ missed }`); clients should re-fetch state over REST.

show.summary: Show countdown and live rundown state (`{ show }`).

overlay.description: Overlay browser-source WebSocket carrying widget snapshots, alerts, music visualizer frames, and display acks.

delete_message.summary: Remove moderated chat message from overlay chatbox.

delete_user.summary: Remove all messages from a timed-out/banned user.

inbound_ack.summary: Client -> server alert playback acknowledgment: `{ type: 'ack', data: { alert_id, phase } }`.

inbound_hello.summary: Client -> server on connect: where to resume from (`{ since_seq }`).

inbound_visibility.summary: Client -> server browser source visibility telemetry: `{ type: 'visibility', data: { visible } }`.

revoked.summary: Overlay token was rotated or deleted; client should stop reconnecting.

snapshot.summary: Initial full overlay config + widget state on connect.

tts.summary: Play synthesized TTS audio in overlay.

tts_stop.summary: Stop active overlay TTS playback and clear queued lines (optionally scoped to `ids`).

AutoConfigCandidate.description: One encoder setting that was tested, with its verdict in plain words.

AutoConfigUploadCheck.description: The upload speed check that went before the benchmark.

problem.description: Present only when the platform could not be checked.

AutoConfigView.description: The auto-config state machine, as the REST routes answer and as the `auto_config` live frame carries.

confirm_remaining_s.description: Seconds left to keep the applied settings before they roll back.

watch_remaining_s.description: Seconds left of the first-minute dropped-frame watch.

info.description: Clients authenticate on `/api/v1/live` using `Authorization: Bearer fc_key_...` (recommended), `?key=...`, or `?session=...`. Reconnecting with `?since=<seq>` replays buffered frames in order. Overlay browser sources connect to `/o/{token}/ws`.
info.summary: Real-time event, queue, status, studio telemetry, and browser-source overlay streams.
info.title: Ferrocast Live & Overlay WebSocket API

receiveLiveFrames.summary: Subscribe to real-time filtered stream events and state updates over `/api/v1/live`.

receiveOverlayFrames.summary: Receive overlay alert and widget render frames on `/o/{token}/ws`.

sendOverlayAck.summary: Report alert start/finish acknowledgement from overlay page.
